pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal patches with moderately soft pixel gradients at the boundaries. The patches exhibit a high spatial area relative to the inter-patch regions, with a saturated brown color that lightens slightly towards the center of some polygons.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-tan interstitial pathways. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radiate. The pixel thickness of the corridors is relatively uniform across the visible mid-section, forming a stable topological grid.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude serrated silhouette visible along the upper neck and shoulder junction. The mane hairs create a dense, fine-textured edge against the background foliage.
